subject: BlueBridge renewal: term origination, capacity ask & QBR slot request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@bluebridge.com>, Marcus Cho <mcho@bluebridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueBridge renewal: term origination, capacity ask & QBR slot request

Hi Ellen / Marcus —

Hope you both had a good weekend. As we approach BlueBridge's renewal window (Jan 2029), I wanted to start the renewal origination conversation so we can lock in terms and capacity without disrupting your ML rollout. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm expected average monthly token volume and any planned bursts (forecasts for Nov 2028 — Mar 2029).
- Decide whether you want to move from our hosted plan to a reserved Dedicated pool or keep hosted with a burst buffer.
- Confirm target term: 12 vs 24 months (we often recommend 24 for committed pricing and additional burst credits).

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick QBR (30–45m) next week to review usage, capacity, and proposed commercial options.
2) Share a short mutual action plan (attached) so legal/finance can see timelines for PO and DocuSign.
3) If you want earlier capacity guarantees, we can propose a short-term reserve addendum.

Suggested QBR slots (PST):
- Wed 2028-09-13 09:00–09:45
- Thu 2028-09-14 11:00–11:45
- Tue 2028-09-19 14:00–14:45

Monica (CC) will own the commercial proposal; Naomi will provide the capacity headroom and burst options. Could you confirm availability and whether you want a 12- or 24-month term discussion? If you already have a renewals timeline internally, please share it.

Attachments: BB4721_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (MVP timeline & responsibilities), term-change-proposal-2028-09-05.pdf (pricing sketch)

Thanks —
Karthik

Karthik Iyer

karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueBridge renewal: term origination, capacity ask & QBR slot request

Thanks, Karthik — this is timely. We are targeting a renewal decision by mid-Dec so Jan 2029 start is correct for planning. A few quick notes from our side:

- Forecasts: current prod usage averages ~1.2B tokens/month. We have two pilot features that could increase steady-state by ~40% starting Feb. We expect 10–12x bursts during Black Friday testing windows.
- Preferred term: leaning toward 24 months, but need to see the detailed pricing.
- Legal/finance: Marcus will own the PO flow; I will loop procurement once we have the MAP and SOW.

The Thu 9/14 11:00 PST slot works for both Marcus and me. Can you include an agenda with expected attendees and a short list of questions we should prepare? Also can you confirm whether the Dedicated option requires a 90-day lead time for GPU allocation?

Best,
Ellen

Ellen Park
Head of Product | BlueBridge
ellen@bluebridge.com | 415-555-9876
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen@bluebridge.com>, Marcus Cho <mcho@bluebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueBridge renewal: term origination, capacity ask & QBR slot request

Thanks Ellen — noted on forecast and bursts. Quick internal notes for the QBR (Monica to lead commercial):

- Agenda draft (30–45m): 1) Current usage & forecast (Naomi) 2) Capacity options (Hosted vs Dedicated) 3) Commercial sketch & term tradeoffs (Monica) 4) Timeline & MAP review (Karthik) 5) Open Qs / next steps.
- For Dedicated: Naomi, is 90-day allocation lead time accurate for the GPU profile BlueBridge uses (A40 / L4 family)?
- I'll prepare two price ladders (12m vs 24m) with burst add-on and a short note about Reserved capacity SLA availability.

I'll slot time to finalize the MAP and send updated attachments before the 9/14 meeting.

—Monica

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: BlueBridge renewal: term origination, capacity ask & QBR slot request (calendar invite + updated MAP)

Ellen / Marcus —

Thanks for confirming — I just sent a calendar invite for Thu, 2028-09-14 11:00–11:45 PST. Agenda (attached in the invite):

1) Usage & forecast summary (Naomi)
2) Capacity options and lead times (Naomi)
3) Commercial overview: 12m vs 24m (Monica)
4) Mutual Action Plan & next milestones (Karthik)

Attachments included here: BB4721_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (updated: added procurement checkpoints), term-change-proposal-2028-09-05.pdf (pricing sketch). I also linked the HubSpot deal and the shared MAP folder (links below).

A few pre-reads that will speed the meeting:
- Short usage export (Naomi will paste a table in the meeting)
- Current contract (for quick redlines) — if Marcus can share procurement-specific timing, we can map dates in the MAP.

Action items before the QBR:
- Marcus: confirm whether procurement needs an internal approval deadline (e.g., 30 days before PO).
- Ellen: confirm whether Black Friday testing windows are flexible or fixed so we can size burst buffer.
- Naomi: validate Dedicated GPU lead time for A40/L4 and provide an interim hosted burst option if Dedicated won't be ready by Nov.
- Monica: finalize the two commercial ladders and put optional burst credits into the proposal.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BB-4721, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-MAP-BB4721

See you on Thu.

Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
